summary: A final netstat check contradicted the primary V20 segment's cleanup assumption: port 8825 still listened on Node PID 11184 after the supervised shell ended. Read-only process start time and /health identified it as the lane-015 PLAYABLE ALPHA V20 REFLECTION ROUTES child. The exact PID was stopped, and a repeated socket check confirmed no remaining 8825 listener.

After the V20 child stopped, port 8805 was listening under PID 17756. Its /health identified foreign game 013-toonfall-gatewatch PLAYABLE BETA; it was observed only and left untouched. No V20 runtime is active.

The append-only correction preserves the transient cleanup discrepancy rather than rewriting the sealed primary segment. V20 source, regression, package, capability, and visual evidence remain admitted; all physical-phone, intended-router, target-hardware, human quality, breadth, and steward-approval gates remain open.
